newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PTTEP International Yankee notes priced - bankers.
newsitem.headline: PTTEP International Yankee notes priced - bankers.

text.p: PTTEP International's US$200 million senior unsecured note issue due 2006 were priced earlier this week to yield 85 basis points over comparable Treasuries, bankers said on Thursday.
PTTEP International is a wholly owned subsidiary of PTT Exploration and Production Co, which is 71 percent owned by the Petroleum Authority of Thailand, the state oil company.
The 10-year notes were sold under U.S. Securities and Exchange Act Rule 144A. They are rated A2 by Moody's Investors Service and Single-A by Standard and Poor's Corp.
The issue was lead managed by CS First Boston.
